name: @caotang/import-csv
description: The spreadsheet reader for the CSV/TSV import (#288): an RFC 4180 grid with delimiter sniffing (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), quoted newlines, a synonym table that guesses each column's role, and codex or timeline rows with dates read only in the format the writer picked. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
